column1: # WHAT THE VENTURE HOLDS, AND WHAT IT OWES. Append-only. Same shape as
# inventory_log.tsv on purpose -- a proven pattern, not a new one.
# *** THIS IS NOT THE PARTY'S PROPERTY. *** wool_venture.md's own words, on the
# return goods: "The return trade is the party's money, the party's judgement,
# the party's risk... NOT in the shared pool." The venture is a separate thing
# the party has a stake in (campaign/venture_shares.tsv says how big a stake),
# and inventory_log.tsv / carry.tsv already answer what the PARTY owns and
# carries. A physical thing belongs in exactly one of these logs, never both --
# see carry.tsv's own header for what happened the last time one fact had two
# homes.
# *** SCOPE, PLAYER'S OWN WORDS, DAY 103: (a) what it physically holds and
# (b) the money position -- who is owed what. NOT (c) valuation, which
# depends on market positions and gets figured out when needed, not
# routinely. *** So this file has no price column and computes none.
# `asset` is one of:
#   a real good        an id from assets.tsv (e.g. `wool`) -- answers (a)
#   `venture_capital`   kind=debt in assets.tsv: money the VENTURE owes BACK
#                       to the party -- capital outstanding, not yet returned
#   `venture_payable_holders`
#                       kind=payable in assets.tsv: money the venture owes OUT
#                       to a shareholder
#   these last two answer (b): who is owed what, and by whom
# `holder` for a real good is who is minding it (closed the same way
# carry.tsv's `who` is: characters.tsv name, people.tsv id, or places.tsv id).
# For a capital/payable row, `holder` is WHO THE MONEY IS OWED TO -- `party`
# for venture_capital (the venture owes the party), or the venture_shares.tsv
# holder id it is owed to for a payable row.
# verb    anchor (sets outright) | move (adds, negative to remove -- e.g. a
#         payable discharged)

column9: *** THE SECOND WOOL BUY, DAY 73-83, NEVER GIVEN A PHYSICAL ROW ANYWHERE UNTIL NOW. *** 36 tods at the published 8 gp floor, 288 gp paid (book=art7 -- Wend's venture money, does not move the party's purse). It was tracked only as an EXPOSURE against art.7's 500 gp seasonal cap; nothing recorded that the party -- or anyone -- actually HOLDS 36 tods of wool. No sale of this lot is on record as of day 103, so it is presumed UNSOLD and with Wend, who holds the venture's stock. The first lot (day 12-16) is fully accounted for: it SOLD entire at Ludbury, day 25-27, and nothing of it remains

The 288 gp of the day 73-83 wool buy is the party's own capital, same as the original 450. CAPITAL RETURNS FIRST (wool_venture.md) -- this is owed back to the party off the top the day this lot of wool sells, before any profit is divided by share. The original 450 gp was put in AND returned entirely within the day 12-16 to day 25-27 window, before the day-39 money anchor, so it has no separate row here -- it is closed history, not an open position

*** OPEN, AND FLAGGED RATHER THAN ASSUMED DISCHARGED. *** wool_venture.md's day 25-27 reckoning: "Six holders' shares -- COIN, in the strongbox, coming home." campaign/loops.tsv L003 opened day 34 naming this exact 229 gp and has NO CLOSE ROW as of day 103 -- sixty-nine days. This project has already been burned once by a stale-looking-live warning (Ancel's "Unanswered", true for two days and quoted as live for forty-three). Anchored here as OWED rather than silently marked paid; if it was in fact handed over, the discharging event needs a negative row here AND an L003 close citing it
